name: print-social-post-set-university-duotone-coral-blue
title: Coral/blue duotone university social post set
whatItIs: A five-post Instagram set for a sign-language university course, mixing duotone-treated photos in coral and blue with flat color panels and consistent geometric triangle accents.
whatItMeans: Alternating duotone photo tiles with flat color tiles in the same two-color palette keeps a photo-heavy set feeling unified rather than like disconnected stock images.
techniques: duotone-treat all photography into just two brand colors for instant cohesion
alternate photo tiles with flat-color text tiles across a grid for visual rhythm
repeat a small geometric accent shape (triangle) across every tile as a brand signature

vocabulary.definition: an image treatment mapping shadows and highlights to two chosen colors instead of full color or greyscale
